text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at the autumn Tenno Sho. Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black are ecstatic to finally be here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has always looked up to Mejiro McQueen. But she's not here to admire her today—she's here to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With their dream race finally a reality, Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black both declare their intent to claim victory!
